info.title: Conference Partner API
info.description: Read-only REST API over the Conference Partner dataset: academic conferences and journals with CFPs, deadlines, locations, CCF / ICORE / QUALIS rankings, curated ranking lists and site statistics. Authentication: search, ranking-list and statistics endpoints need NO credentials — call them directly; anonymous clients share a small daily quota counted per source IP (HTTP 429 when exhausted). The unit is the distinct query: repeating a request already made the same day (same path, same parameters) does not consume quota again. Only the per-venue detail endpoints (/api/conferences/{id}, /api/journals/{id}, /api/researchers/{id}) require a free-account credential — either an API key created at https://www.myhuiban.com/account/api-keys (starts with hb_, never expires, revocable individually) or a JWT from POST /api/login; both are sent as `Authorization: Bearer <credential>` and both raise the daily quota (shared with the MCP server at POST /mcp; HTTP 402 when exhausted). An invalid, revoked or expired credential returns HTTP 401 and is never silently downgraded to the anonymous tier — omit the header entirely to use it. CORS is open on every endpoint. Responses link each venue to its canonical Conference Partner detail_page and do not expose the external website. Send a descriptive User-Agent on every request (e.g. "my-lab-deadline-bot/1.0 (+https://example.edu/contact)"): the site is behind Cloudflare, whose Browser Integrity Check rejects a few unattended-script defaults at the edge with HTTP 403 and body "error code: 1010" before the request reaches the API — confirmed for Python urllib's default (Python-urllib/x.y) and Perl LWP's (libwww-perl/x.y). requests, httpx, curl, Go, Node and Bun clients send their own and are unaffected. A 403 with that body is neither an auth nor a quota error: only a real User-Agent fixes it. Every active conference also carries cp_index, the Conference Partner Index (CP-I): our own transparent 0-100 score with its per-factor breakdown and a confidence value; the complete method is published at https://www.myhuiban.com/ranking. Developer guide: https://www.myhuiban.com/developers — ranking definitions and update cadence: https://www.myhuiban.com/methodology — LLM-oriented site description: https://www.myhuiban.com/llms.txt.

post.summary: Exchange email/password for a JWT bearer token

200.description: Token issued (data.token / data.token_type / data.expires_in / data.user_id); invalid credentials return body code 401

get.description: Every parameter is optional — combine any of keyword, ranking, research field and submission/conference date ranges. Filter-only queries are supported.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keyword matched against short name and full name (case-insensitive). Optional — filter-only queries (e.g. field + deadline window, no keyword) are supported.

parameters.name: core_rank
parameters.description: ICORE rank: A* / A / B / C (use raw value).

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Research field (21 areas: computer science plus adjacent engineering and science disciplines, auto-tagged from venue full names).

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Incremental sync: only venues changed on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Day granularity; venues never edited have no change record and are omitted. Checkpoint on the updated_at field of the results.

200.description: Paged list: data.conferences[] (Conference) + data.pagination; validation errors return body code 400

get.summary: Browse conference lists and rankings (no keyword needed)
get.description: Same data as the public list pages and the MCP list_conferences tool. Use this to enumerate the data set page by page.

parameters.name: ranking
parameters.description: cfp=open calls for papers; past_cfp=expired calls; ccf/core/qualis=venues in that tier whose submission deadline has not passed (for the whole tier catalogue, search GET /api/conferences with ccf_rank / core_rank / qualis_rank instead); cp_index=every conference we track, ordered by the Conference Partner Index (the only one of these lists that covers the whole catalogue rather than a fifth of it); most_viewed/most_tracked/most_attended=popularity; most_competitive=lowest acceptance rate; upcoming/past=by conference date; trending=most viewed in the last 30 days

200.description: data.ranking + data.conferences[] (Conference, some rankings add trackers_count / attendees_count / acceptance_rate / views_30d) + data.pagination (count / has_more); unknown ranking returns body code 400

get.summary: Get full conference detail by id
get.description: Basics, CFP text, acceptance-rate history, edition history, structured ratings and comments, related conferences/journals — same as the MCP get_conference tool. Requires an account token; responses link to detail_page (the canonical Conference Partner page) rather than the venue's external website.

200.description: data = Conference plus cfp_text / rating_summary / acceptance[] / history[] / trackers_count / attendees_count / related_conferences[] / related_journals[] / comments[]; missing id returns HTTP 404

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keyword matched against journal full/short name.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Research field (21 areas: computer science plus adjacent engineering and science disciplines, auto-tagged from venue full names).

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Incremental sync: only venues changed on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Day granularity; venues never edited have no change record and are omitted. Checkpoint on the updated_at field of the results.

200.description: Paged list: data.journals[] (Journal) + data.pagination; validation errors return body code 400

get.summary: Browse journal lists and rankings (no keyword needed)
get.description: Same data as the public list pages and the MCP list_journals tool. Use this to enumerate the data set page by page.

parameters.name: ranking
parameters.description: cfp=special-issue calls for papers; ccf=CCF list; highest_if=highest impact factor; most_viewed/most_tracked=popularity; all=all journals

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Research field filter, only for ranking=cfp or ranking=all (other rankings return body code 400). ranking=cfp&field=network = network journals with an open special issue, soonest deadline first.

200.description: data.ranking + data.journals[] (Journal; ranking=cfp adds special_issue {title, submission_date, id, detail_page} — one row per open special issue, so a journal can repeat) + data.pagination (count / has_more) + data.field when filtered; unknown ranking or field returns body code 400

get.summary: Get full journal detail by id
get.description: Basics, CFP text, special issues, structured ratings and comments, related journals/conferences — same as the MCP get_journal tool. Requires an account token; responses link to detail_page (the canonical Conference Partner page) rather than the venue's external website.

200.description: data = Journal plus cfp_text / rating_summary / special_issues[] / trackers_count / related_journals[] / related_conferences[] / comments[]; missing id returns HTTP 404

get.summary: Get a researcher's public profile by id
get.description: Name, institution, auto-generated research-interest summary, CV, tracked/attended conferences and tracked journals — same as the MCP get_researcher tool. Requires an account token. **Contact details are never included**, and only individual profiles are exposed: there is no researcher search or enumeration endpoint (mirrors the website, where the researcher directory requires login). Profiles failing the anti-spam / email-verification guard are reported as HTTP 404.

Conference/journal totals, conferences with an open call for papers, upcoming deadlines by month, open CFPs broken down by CCF / ICORE / QUALIS tier, conference country and research-field distributions, journal impact-factor, CCF-tier, publisher and research-field distributions — same as the MCP get_statistics tool. Research-field keys are the same slugs the search endpoints accept in their field parameter.

200.description: data.conferences_total / journals_total / conferences_with_open_cfp / conference_deadline_by_month / conference_open_cfp_by_ccf_rank / conference_open_cfp_by_core_rank / conference_open_cfp_by_qualis_rank / conference_country_distribution / conference_field_distribution / journal_impact_factor_distribution / journal_ccf_rank_distribution / journal_publisher_distribution / journal_field_distribution

bearerAuth.description: Free-account credential, either form: an API key created at https://www.myhuiban.com/account/api-keys (starts with `hb_`, never expires, revocable individually, metered per key — this is the one to use with MCP clients that only take a URL plus a fixed header), or a JWT issued by POST /api/login (valid ~6 months, not individually revocable). Send as `Authorization: Bearer <credential>`. All credentials on an account share one daily quota, itself shared with the MCP server; quota exhaustion returns HTTP 402, an unusable credential returns HTTP 401.

paidAccess.name: X-Paid-Access
paidAccess.description: Per-request x402 payment channel — PLANNED, NOT YET LIVE. The origin recognises this header once the edge injects it after verifying a payment, but the edge-side gateway is not enabled, so clients currently cannot pay per request. Use the anonymous tier or a free-account API key / JWT instead.

ApiResponse.description: Uniform envelope: business code mirrors HTTP semantics (200 success; validation errors return HTTP 200 with code 400 in the body; missing entities return HTTP 404).

count.description: Ranking endpoints only: rows in this page

Conference.description: Conference row. Responses never include the external website; use detail_page (the canonical Conference Partner page).

ccf_rank.description: A / B / C, empty when unranked

core_rank.description: A* / A / B / C, empty when unranked

updated_at.description: Date this venue was last changed; null if never edited. Use as the updated_since checkpoint.

cp_index.description: Conference Partner Index (CP-I): our own 0-100 score, computed daily for every active conference from five published factors. Null for venues we have not scored. 50 is the neutral baseline used for unknown factors, so always read score together with confidence. The organizer of a venue can raise it only by supplying data (acceptance rates, past editions, best papers) - there is no paid path. Full method: https://www.myhuiban.com/ranking

score.description: 0-100; 50 is the neutral baseline, not a midpoint of observed values

rank.description: Position among all scored conferences (ties share a rank)

confidence.description: Share of the score backed by observed data rather than the neutral baseline (0.25-1.0)

factors.description: Per-factor scores 0-100; null means we hold no data for that factor and it was scored at the neutral baseline

community.description: Followers and readers within the Conference Partner community, not global popularity (weight 10%)

openness.description: Completeness of the public record; documentation, not academic quality (weight 15%)

algorithm.description: Algorithm version; scores are only comparable within one version

Researcher.description: Public researcher profile. Contact details (email) are never included. List fields are truncated; the matching *_count field carries the untruncated total.

research_profile.description: System-generated research-interest summary (null when the user has too little browsing and tracking activity)

Journal.description: Journal row. Responses never include the external website; use detail_page.

ccf_rank.description: A / B / C, empty when unranked

updated_at.description: Date this venue was last changed; null if never edited. Use as the updated_since checkpoint.

Unauthorized.description: This endpoint needs credentials (only the per-venue detail endpoints do), or the credential sent is invalid / revoked / expired: send Authorization: Bearer <credential> — an API key from https://www.myhuiban.com/account/api-keys or a JWT from POST /api/login. Omit the header entirely to use the anonymous tier

QuotaExhausted.description: Account daily quota exhausted (shared across REST API and MCP); retry after the daily reset, or email admin@myhuiban.com for a higher limit

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the daily quota resets (midnight UTC). Wait this long before retrying; retrying sooner just burns more rejected requests.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests: either the per-minute rate limit, or the anonymous per-source-IP daily quota (register a free account to raise it; note that repeating an identical query the same day does not consume it again, so hitting this means distinct queries, not retries). Check X-RateLimit-* / X-Quota-* response headers to tell them apart. When it is the daily quota, Retry-After says how long until it resets — wait that long rather than retrying immediately. Scheduled pollers should also use updated_since to fetch only what changed.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the daily quota resets (midnight UTC). Wait this long before retrying; retrying sooner just burns more rejected requests.
